guide.summary: A pretend chemical that slows and harms only yeasts and fungi.
guide.biology: Some real substances harm certain kinds of microbes more than others; this made-up chemical stands in for that broad idea.
guide.rules: Adds an abstract inhibitor that dissolves, diffuses and loses 0.2 % of its amount each tick. It targets only the yeasts and fungi Y01 Bubble, Y02 Creambud, F01 Threadlace, F02 Cordweaver, F03 Traplace and F04 Sporeveil. A target's exposure is the local amount, halved once in a cell with biofilm; its growth is multiplied by 1 / (1 + exposure) and it loses 8 times the exposure in health each second. Bacteria, algae, consumers, parasites and viruses are unaffected. No additional modeled reaction. This is an abstract game mechanic, not a claim about how any real product works.
guide.example: Add a small dose where Bubbles and Sprinters share sugar and see which group takes over.
